② Leg swings, lunges, arm circles, 10 each.

slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
A few quick hamstring stretches in the car park isn't really a warm-up, as Toto found out.

Research suggests structured warm-ups can reduce some sport injuries, particularly in team sports. A simple version: three to five minutes of easy jogging, then dynamic moves like leg swings, walking lunges and arm circles, then a few short efforts close to game speed.

It takes about ten minutes and means you're ready from the first whistle. A sudden pop, fast swelling or a joint that gives way is worth getting assessed rather than strapping up and playing on.
